item.title: Remarkable Women: Charlotte woman's nonprofit, The Sandbox, aids families with sick children
item.description: Mara Campolungo was awarded the Charlotte-area's 2026 Remarkable Women winner for her work creating The Sandbox, a non-profit that supports families navigating life with a child diagnosed with a life-altering illness.

item.title: SC Environmental Services calls for investigation, pause after chemical leak at Silfab Solar Facility in Fort Mill
item.description: The South Carolina Department of Environmental Services is calling on Silfab Solar to stop receiving additional chemicals and pause its startup process following a chemical spill at its Fort Mill facility on Tuesday.

item.title: Waymo's driverless cars spark safety worries across the country
item.description: Waymo's self-driving cars have been involved in two incidents, including blocking an emergency vehicle in Austin, Texas, and illegally passing a stopped school bus, raising safety questions among first responders and the public.

item.title: Charlotte-area Rep. Carla Cunningham easily ousted in Democratic primary to opponent supported by Stein
item.description: Her District 106 includes the Highland Creek and Mallard Creek areas of Charlotte, plus southeastern Huntersville.

item.title: Cooper, Whatley set November matchup in North Carolina Senate race
item.description: Former Republican National Committee Chair Michael Whatley and former Gov. Roy Cooper (D) were projected to win their respective Senate primaries on Tuesday, setting up a November matchup as Democrats eye a pickup opportunity in North Carolina.
